body.x: In heavy smoke and a blackout, a fixed exit sign is useless the moment it disappears from view, and an announcement cannot say which way is still safe. A light that flies ahead and leads people out answers the question in real time.
LEADWAY and Hanseo University received a 2027 Best of Innovation award in Smart Communities at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for LEADWAY, an autonomous dynamic evacuation guidance system.

LEADWAY replaces static exit signs with autonomous drones that fly ahead of evacuees and physically lead them out. Units patrol continuously, so the drone that first identifies a fire signals standby units to deploy across the building within seconds, where in heavy smoke and power outages fixed signage and building-wide announcements cannot tell anyone which way is still safe.

It uses high-visibility directional lighting as the primary cue, extending the visible route from 1 to 8 meters and raising route recognition from 46 percent to 91 percent, with onboard voice guidance as a supporting layer. Thermal and vision sensors locate stranded occupants and re-route crowds away from compromised exits, while a mesh network keeps every unit and arriving first responders on one live picture.
Across offices, residential buildings, transit hubs and schools, LEADWAY targets a drop in evacuation time from 12 to 7 minutes.

The CES Innovation Awards program, an annual competition honoring outstanding design and engineering in consumer technology products, recognizes all recipients as Honorees at two levels. The Honoree level covers products that score above the scoring threshold in each category, while Best of Innovation goes to the highest-scoring Honorees. A panel of industry expert judges and global media scores each product on engineering and functionality, aesthetic and design, and what makes it unique and innovative.

AVING NEWS, a global media company with 21 years of experience covering CES, operates AVING CES Newsroom (avingces.news), a dedicated platform for delivering the latest innovations to global audiences. Publishing more than 1,000 articles and conducting hundreds of on-site video interviews annually, AVING NEWS has helped Korean startups gain international visibility and expand their global reach. At CES 2027, AVING NEWS will operate the AVING TECH TALK broadcast zone at the Venetian Expo (Hall A, Booth 50271), providing on-site coverage and interviews that spotlight Korean companies and their latest innovations.
